title: Director - Product Management
jobDescription:
About Simplify Healthcare Simplify Healthcare, a Simplify Group company, is a leading healthcare technology company focused on transforming how U.S. health plans (Payers) operate across benefits, provider, and claims functions. We build cloud-based, AI-driven Saa S platforms that modernize core payer workflows and enable scalable, complaint, and efficient operations. Our flagship platform, Simplify Health Cloud™ brings together enterprise-grade solutions for product configuration, benefits administration, provider lifecycle management, claims operations, and experience orchestration. Designed specifically for the U.S. health insurance ecosystem, our platforms support real-world regulatory complexity, operational scale, and continuous change. Headquartered in Chicago with a Global Development & Delivery Center in Pune and a global workforce of 900+ professionals, Simplify Healthcare supports more than 70 U.S. health plans. We are a bootstrapped, debt-free organization with over 18 years of profitable growth, combining long-term stability with a strong execution culture. As we enter our next phase of growth, we continue to invest in applied AI, platform modernization, and leadership talent to shape the future of payer technology. About the Role We are looking for a strategic and execution-focused product leader to shape, scale, and modernize our healthcare payer product portfolio. This role combines product vision, business ownership, AI-driven innovation, and operational excellence
- requiring a leader who can think long-term while delivering measurable business outcomes in the near term. As Director
- Product Management, you will lead strategic product initiatives across healthcare payer workflows while partnering with executive leadership, customers, engineering, architecture, UX, analytics, AI teams, and go-to-market organizations to define the future of our platform. The ideal candidate will bring strong healthcare payer expertise, enterprise Saa S product leadership, business acumen, and a passion for AI-enabled digital transformation. What You Will Own Product Vision, Strategy & Roadmap Define and execute a differentiated product strategy aligned to market opportunities, customer needs, and business growth objectives. Own multi-year roadmap planning and prioritization across strategic product areas. Drive innovation across the healthcare payer product portfolio leveraging AI/ML, automation, predictive analytics, and intelligent workflows. Identify opportunities to modernize payer operations through digital transformation and AI-enabled capabilities. Ensure platform scalability, usability, configurability, and operational excellence. AI & Digital Transformation Leadership Drive adoption of Generative AI, intelligent automation, conversational AI, and decision-support capabilities across payer workflows. Partner with AI, analytics, engineering, and architecture teams to define scalable AI-driven product solutions. Evaluate emerging industry trends related to AI-enabled healthcare platforms, interoperability, workflow modernization, and operational automation. Champion responsible AI principles including governance, explainability, security, compliance, and healthcare data privacy. Lead transformation initiatives that improve operational efficiency, customer experience, and business outcomes. Leadership & Team Building Build, mentor, and lead high-performing Product Managers and cross-functional product teams. Establish a strong product culture focused on customer outcomes, accountability, innovation, collaboration, and measurable impact. Coach and develop next-generation product leaders with strong business and healthcare domain expertise. Foster a proactive, execution-oriented, and data-driven decision-making culture. Drive organizational product maturity, product operating models, and best practices. End-to-End Product Lifecycle Ownership Drive product development from concept → strategy → execution → launch → adoption → optimization. Partner closely with Engineering, UX, QA, Architecture, and Delivery teams to deliver high-quality enterprise Saa S products. Own prioritization decisions balancing customer value, scalability, technical investments, and business impact. Ensure timely delivery of releases while maintaining quality, compliance, security, and operational readiness. Oversee release communication, demos, training enablement, and product adoption strategies. Market, Customer & Domain Leadership Leverage deep healthcare payer expertise across Benefits, Claims, Prior Authorization, Provider, Member, and Clinical workflows. Build strong executive-level relationships with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders. Conduct market analysis, competitive benchmarking, and customer research to identify product opportunities. Translate complex healthcare business requirements into scalable platform capabilities and configurable product solutions. Bring customer-centric thinking into all product decisions by understanding operational pain points, user journeys, and adoption challenges. Business Ownership & Growth Own product-level growth metrics including ACV, adoption, customer satisfaction, retention, and platform expansion opportunities. Partner with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Implementation teams to drive product positioning and revenue growth. Support strategic customer engagements, executive presentations, roadmap discussions, and pre-sales initiatives. Influence investment decisions through strong business cases, market insights, and product strategy alignment. Drive measurable business outcomes through product innovation and operational transformation. Cross-Platform & Global Collaboration Collaborate across multiple product ecosystems and enterprise platform initiatives. Work effectively across global teams, stakeholders, and delivery organizations. Drive alignment across Product, Engineering, GTM, Operations, Customer Success, and partner ecosystems. Influence cross-functional decision-making in a fast-paced and evolving business environment. What We are Looking For 15+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Leadership, Consulting, or Healthcare Technology leadership roles. Proven experience leading enterprise Saa S products, product organizations, and large-scale platform initiatives. Deep expertise in U.S. healthcare payer domain including Medicare, Medicaid, Commercial, ACA, Claims, Benefits, Provider, and Authorization workflows. Strong understanding of healthcare payer operations, interoperability, utilization management, and claims adjudication workflows. Experience driving digital transformation, AI-enabled product innovation, or workflow automation initiatives. Exposure to AI/ML-driven products, analytics platforms, intelligent automation, or Generative AI capabilities preferred. Strong business acumen with experience owning product growth metrics and strategic business outcomes. Experience working with cloud platforms and modern enterprise architecture (preferably Microsoft Azure). Excellent executive presence, communication, storytelling, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills. Demonstrated ability to influence without authority and lead through ambiguity and organizational change. Proven ability to operate effectively in high-growth, fast-paced, and highly collaborative environments. Bachelor’s degree or international equivalent required. Healthcare domain expertise preferred / good to have. Why This Role Matters This is a mission-critical leadership role that will shape the future of Simplify’s AI-enabled healthcare payer platform portfolio. You will directly influence product innovation, digital transformation strategy, customer outcomes, market positioning, and revenue growth while partnering closely with executive leadership and global healthcare customers.

title: Product Manager
jobDescription:
ROLE:
Simplify Healthcare is the leader in healthcare payer Digital Business Transformation and is looking to build a team of sharp, detail-oriented, self-motivated change agents and domain experts who will enable and improve the digital transformation of fundamental business operations. Define the product vision and create a product roadmap aligned with business goals and market opportunities. Manage the product backlog by anticipating client needs and prioritizing features that deliver measurable business value. Drive product innovation objectives and release content (release notes, product documentation updates, demos, and training artifacts) via prioritized features following Agile best practices. As a Product Manager, you will partner with business, operations, engineering, architecture, UX, analytics, and AI teams throughout the product lifecycle, including vision, requirements, deployment, optimization, and adoption. You are expected to have a strong understanding of healthcare payer systems, workflows, claims operations, and competitive industry offerings while identifying opportunities to modernize processes through AI-enabled capabilities and intelligent automation. The ideal candidate will combine healthcare payer expertise, product management discipline, strategic thinking, customer-centricity, and emerging AI product capabilities to help shape the next generation of digital healthcare solutions.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Define and drive the product vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap aligned with organizational priorities and client objectives. Translate healthcare payer operational challenges into scalable digital and AI-enabled product solutions. Drive product consistency, usability, scalability, and innovation across the platform. Identify opportunities to leverage AI/ML, automation, predictive analytics, generative AI, and intelligent workflows to improve operational efficiency and customer experience. Own and manage the product backlog by balancing customer needs, technical priorities, business objectives, and market opportunities. Work closely with engineering, architecture, UX, QA, analytics, and AI teams to deliver high-quality products and enhancements. Facilitate requirement gathering, prioritization, sprint planning, story refinement, and release planning following Agile best practices. Collaborate with technical teams to evaluate AI-assisted workflows, intelligent automation, decision-support models, and data-driven product capabilities. Ensure timely delivery of product releases while maintaining quality, scalability, security, and compliance standards. Support release readiness through documentation, release notes, demos, training materials, and stakeholder communication. Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders, clients, implementation teams, and executive leadership. Act as the bridge between business and technology teams to ensure alignment and execution clarity. Lead product discussions with clients to understand business goals, operational pain points, and transformation opportunities. Communicate product direction, tradeoffs, priorities, and business impact effectively across technical and non-technical audiences. Influence prioritization decisions through strong analytical thinking, negotiation, and stakeholder management. Anticipate risks, identify blockers early, and proactively drive resolution. Mentor and guide Business Analysts, Product Consultants, Associate Product Managers, and operational teams. Promote a culture of ownership, collaboration, innovation, continuous learning, and accountability. Drive proactive problem solving rather than reactive issue management. Foster cross-functional alignment and ensure clarity of product direction across teams. Contribute to organizational product maturity, AI transformation initiatives, and best practices. Healthcare Domain & Product Expertise Develop deep expertise in healthcare payer workflows including benefits, claims, prior authorization, provider, member, and clinical data. Understand healthcare interoperability standards, payer operations, utilization management, and claims adjudication workflows. Translate healthcare business requirements into scalable platform capabilities and configurable product features. Evaluate feature fitment between standard product functionality and client-specific customization requirements. Bring customer-centric thinking into all product decisions by understanding user workflows, operational pain points, and adoption challenges. AI & Digital Transformation Expectations As part of Simplify Healthcare’s AI-enabled product transformation journey, Product Managers are expected to: Identify opportunities for Generative AI, intelligent automation, conversational AI, and predictive analytics within healthcare payer workflows. Partner with AI, data science, and engineering teams to define AI-driven product use cases and measurable business outcomes. Understand responsible AI principles including explainability, governance, security, compliance, and healthcare data privacy. Drive AI-assisted user experiences that improve operational productivity, decision-making, and customer engagement. Evaluate market trends related to AI-enabled healthcare platforms, digital experience modernization, and workflow automation. Champion adoption of AI-powered product capabilities across clients and internal teams. Requirements: 10-15 years of relevant experience, including product management experience in healthcare technology, payer platforms, or healthcare informatics. Bachelor’s degree or international equivalent required. Strong understanding of Agile methodologies, product lifecycle management, and digital product delivery. Experience working with healthcare data models, operational workflows, and enterprise platform products. Exposure to AI/ML-driven products, analytics platforms, workflow automation, or digital transformation initiatives preferred. Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and executive communication skills. Strong stakeholder management, leadership, negotiation, and influencing skills. Proven track record of delivering enterprise-scale products, process transformation initiatives, and cross-functional programs. Experience collaborating with engineering, UX, architecture, implementation, and client success teams. Ability to thrive in fast-paced, evolving, and highly collaborative environments. Knowledge & understanding of healthcare payer ecosystems including claims, benefits, provider, member, authorization, and clinical workflows. Healthcare domain knowledge is preferred / good to have.

title: Product Marketing Lead
jobDescription:
ROLE:
The Product Marketing Lead plays a pivotal role in bridging the gap between product development and market adoption. You’ll be the voice of our product(s), crafting compelling narratives that resonate with target audiences and drive sales. You’ll wear many hats: strategist, storyteller, analyst, and collaborator
- ultimately ensuring our product(s) achieve maximum impact in the market.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Market Research and Analysis Conduct in-depth research to understand target markets, industry trends, and competitor landscapes. Develop detailed buyer personas and buyer journeys and identify customer pain points. Product Positioning and Messaging Define the unique value proposition and key differentiators for assigned product(s). Develop compelling messaging and communication materials (e.g., product briefs, case studies, presentations, website copy) that clearly articulate the product’s benefits. Ensure consistent messaging across all marketing channels and internal teams. Go-to-Market Strategy and Execution Create and execute comprehensive go-to-market plans for new product launches and major feature updates. Develop launch campaigns and collateral materials across various channels (e.g., email, social media, webinars, events). Manage agency and association relationships and oversee campaign production within budget and timelines. Content Marketing and Storytelling Plan and create engaging content (e.g., blog posts, whitepapers, ebooks, videos) that educates and informs target audiences about the product’s value. Collaborate with content writers and designers to develop high-quality marketing materials. Manage the content, social media, and campaign calendar. Optimize content for search engines and social media platforms. Sales and Support Enablement Equip sales teams with product knowledge, messaging, and competitive battle cards. Develop collateral to support the sales process. Performance Measurement and Optimization Analyze data to measure campaign performance and identify opportunities for improvement and optimization. Refine strategies and tactics based on data insights and market feedback. Must have skills: 5+ years of experience in product marketing at an enterprise B2B Saa S company. Strong writer and communicator, with a knack for storytelling and a track record of building engaging content. Experience developing narratives, marketing programs, and product launches. Portfolio of impactful marketing content, sales enablement materials, customer-facing assets, and a track record of creating successful marketing programs. Ability to work well cross-functionally and across different levels in the organization. Go-getter with experience in driving and launching GTM programs/campaigns.

EDUCATION:
Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field.

title: Director - Product Delivery
jobDescription:
ROLE:
The Director
- Product Delivery is responsible for supporting the VP of Line of Business and the Client Partner, along with helping to manage the company’s overall delivery interaction with client accounts. The emphasis is on ensuring that day-to-day client deliverables are handled with professionalism and knowledge, leading to a positive client response and delivery. This role requires the ability to learn and adapt quickly, solve problems both collectively and independently, and view business problems strategically. Individuals need to be self-motivated and entrepreneurial, and able to thrive in a highly collaborative environment.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Act as the primary point of contact from Simplify Healthcare to work with the client’s project management person/team. Lead internal/external kick-off meetings and facilitate the client discovery phase of projects along with Product Consultants, Business Analysts, and Client Partners. Create project plans based on discovery discussions and documentation, with assistance from Product Consultants and Business Analysts. Act as the primary interface for all customer communications
- project planning, schedules, milestones, status reports, and overall organization of project-related artefacts. Present standard status reports to the client with precise and correct information sourced from various tools and conversations, including project hygiene, sprint/release status, estimated vs. actual efforts, RAID, and query logs. Create and track implementation budget forecasts and spend throughout the implementation timeline, and monitor revenue forecasts in partnership with the Scrum Master. Supervise incident management, change controls, problem management, and scope management from discussions through approvals, working with the Scrum Master and Product Consultant to execute. Lead and guide the cross-functional team
- including product solutions, development, quality assurance, and scrum master
- to ensure effectiveness of implementation. Help clients and internal resources prioritize deliverables in times of conflicting demands. Raise purchase orders. Must have skills: 10-15 years of total experience across Information Technology (products/services), Project Implementation and Optimization, on-shore/off-shore team structure models, and Agile software development. Proven experience in overseeing technology initiatives encompassing application development, Azure, SQL, .NET, and React.js. Flexible with the ability to manage stressful situations and adapt to rapidly changing environments and requirements. Ability to work with Account Teams, Customers, Service Delivery, and Operations. Creative, flexible thinker who is willing to take initiative and share alternative solutions with peers and management. Excellent customer service skills. Passionate and willing to go the extra mile to ensure the highest level of customer satisfaction. Exceptional documentation and communication skills. Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, multi-cultural, customer-oriented environment. Good to have: A foundational understanding of .NET, SQL, and React.js.

EDUCATION:
Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent experience; MBA preferred.

title: Senior QA - Automation
jobDescription:
ROLE:
The Senior QA is responsible for designing, developing, and executing manual and automated test cases while collaborating with teams to meet business and technical requirements, ensuring high-quality software delivery. This role involves identifying defects, analysing issues, improving testing processes, and contributing to overall product quality.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Test Planning and Execution: Develop and execute detailed test plans, test cases, and test scenarios to validate software functionality, usability, and performance. Defect Management: Identify, log, track, and report software defects, ensuring timely resolution by collaborating with development teams. Quality Standards: Ensure compliance with quality assurance processes, guidelines, and best practices throughout the SDLC. Requirement Analysis: Review and analyse business requirements, technical specifications, and use cases to develop robust testing strategies. Automation: Utilize testing tools to execute automated and manual tests when appropriate, ensuring efficiency in the testing lifecycle. Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including developers, product managers, and stakeholders, to deliver high-quality products. Risk Assessment: Evaluate potential risks, prioritize test efforts, and assess impact to ensure reliability of software products. Documentation: Maintain thorough and accurate documentation of test cases, test results, and QA processes. Report clearly on product quality. Client Engagement: Engage and communicate directly with client stakeholders for joint platform testing projects where applicable. Must have skills: Minimum 5+ years of experience in software testing and quality assurance, including at least 1+ year working with an automation tool. Strong understanding of QA methodologies, tools, and processes. Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Experience in testing REST APIs and microservices and familiarity with tools such as Postman. Experience in designing, executing, and reporting performance test cases. Solid understanding of SDLC, STLC, and Agile methodologies. Good to have: Experience in programming languages such as Java, Python, or Java Script. Knowledge of CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, Git Lab) and Test Management tools.

title: Lead QA - Automation
jobDescription:
ROLE:
The QA Lead is responsible for designing, developing, and leading manual and automation testing strategies to ensure high-quality software delivery. This role involves leading the overall test strategy, implementing automation efforts, employing industry best practices, mentoring team members, and driving innovations in overall testing processes.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Automation Framework Development: Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable, and reusable test automation frameworks and tools. Test Strategy and Execution: Develop and implement innovative strategies and industry best practices for testing functional, regression, performance, and API-level scenarios. Team Leadership: Lead and mentor the QA team in automation best practices and tools, fostering collaboration and efficiency. Collaboration: Work closely with developers, product managers, and stakeholders to understand requirements and integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines. Client Engagement: Engage and communicate directly with client stakeholders for joint platform testing projects where applicable. Defect Management: Identify, track, and report bugs effectively, keeping the platform defect rate below 1%. Quality Processes: Drive continuous improvement by evaluating new tools, frameworks, and techniques. Documentation: Create detailed documentation for automation scripts, processes, and frameworks. Reporting: Develop and share visual dashboards and executive reports on platform quality at the executive level, reporting into the Product Leader (Sr. Product Manager). Must have skills: 7-12 years of testing experience, including a minimum of 5 years working with automation tools and strategies. Proven experience in transitioning to an automated test framework from a previously manual one. Experience working with one or more automation tools (e.g., Selenium, Appium, JMeter, Testim, etc.). Experience leading a team of at least 5-10 QA analysts. Knowledge of CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, Git Lab) and Test Management tools. Experience in testing REST APIs and microservices, and familiarity with tools such as Postman. Experience in designing, executing, and reporting performance test cases. Solid understanding of SDLC, STLC, and Agile methodologies. Strong leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills. Good to have: Experience in programming languages such as Java, Python, or Java Script.

title: Lead - Docs
jobDescription:
ROLE:
The Docs Lead will drive healthcare product configuration, documentation workflows, and data management for US healthcare clients. This role requires strong leadership in SDLC execution, benefits configuration, claims data validation, and automation initiatives. The Lead will guide analysts, ensure SLA-driven delivery, and implement continuous improvements while adhering to US healthcare compliance standards.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Own and deliver product configuration, healthcare documentation, and support across payer operations. Translate client and business requirements into system configuration and design specifications. Lead a team of 8-12 analysts, providing coaching, mentoring, and technical guidance. Ensure compliance with HIPAA and US healthcare documentation and data privacy requirements. Drive automation initiatives (e.g., benefit data validation, claims documentation workflows) using HTML, BPM, RPA, or related tools. Track and report SLA adherence, productivity metrics, error rates, and client satisfaction. Partner with US healthcare stakeholders to capture requirements, oversee testing, and resolve escalations. Promote a culture of knowledge sharing, innovation, and continuous improvement. Must have skills: 6-8 years of experience in healthcare product configuration, documentation management, or payer operations. At least 1-2 years of experience as a team lead or senior individual contributor with mentoring responsibilities. Strong knowledge of healthcare benefits setup, documentation, and claims data workflows. Experience with automation tools, document management systems, and scripting (HTML preferred). Strong analytical, problem-solving, and client-facing skills. Understanding of SDLC, healthcare IT systems, and compliance-driven delivery. KRAs / KPIs: SLA Adherence: ≥95% across deliverables. Team Productivity: Demonstrable year-on-year efficiency improvements. Quality: ≤2% error rate in outputs. Initiatives: Deliver a minimum of 2 new initiatives annually. Engagement: Improved employee retention and skill development metrics.

title: Events & Program Manager
jobDescription:
ROLE:
The Events & Program Manager will support the planning, coordination, and execution of external conferences, customer events, partner engagements, and Simplify Healthcare’s flagship annual Connect Conference. The role involves researching event opportunities, managing operational workflows, coordinating with vendors and stakeholders, tracking budgets, and generating insights to optimize ROI and event experience. This is a hands-on role that requires strong organization, communication, and analytical capabilities.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Event Research & Intake Identify and evaluate relevant industry conferences, summits, and networking forums aligned to strategic business priorities. Analyze event fit based on attendee profile, sponsorship models, competitive presence, speaking opportunities, and potential pipeline impact. Present event recommendations and maintain an active event calendar. Event Planning & Coordination Create event plans, timelines, and execution checklists for each sponsored or attended event. Coordinate with internal stakeholders (Marketing, Sales, Product, Customer Success) for speaking content, collateral, demos, and attendee coordination. Liaise with organizers, venue teams, booth vendors, AV teams, and merchandise suppliers for flawless execution. Maintain clear and consistent communication across teams pre-, during-, and post-event. Connect Conference Support (Flagship Event) Assist in planning and operational execution of Connect
- including venue coordination, stage and AV setup, signage planning, attendee registration workflows, travel coordination, partner/sponsor engagement support, collateral planning, hospitality, and onsite logistics. Manage vendor timelines, budgets, deliverables, and internal task trackers. Support speaker management, rehearsal scheduling, and run-of-show planning. Provide on-ground support during Connect to ensure a seamless attendee and executive experience. Budget & Documentation Management Track event budgets, vendor quotes, contracts, and invoices. Maintain procurement checklists, spend logs, and compliance alignment. Ensure timely closure of documentation and post-event expense reporting. On-Ground / Virtual Event Support Support booth setup, branding placement, collaterals, promotional merchandise, and technology requirements. Monitor execution quality, troubleshoot issues, and ensure a seamless experience for attendees and internal teams. Post-Event Reporting & Analytics Develop structured event summary reports including leads, engagement data, cost analysis, and recommendations. Track follow-up actions with Sales and Marketing to support pipeline progression. Maintain event performance dashboards for quarterly/annual review. Must have skills: 8+ years of experience in event operations, marketing coordination, or conference support (B2B preferred). Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously with attention to detail. Proficiency in Excel, Power Point, and collaboration/project management tools. Strong organization, ownership mindset, and ability to work with remote/global teams. Willingness to adjust schedule occasionally for US time zone meetings. Good to have: Experience working on large-scale corporate conferences or multi-track events. Familiarity with CRM/marketing automation workflows (e.g., Hub Spot, Salesforce, Zoho, etc.). Comfort working in fast-paced, changing environments.

EDUCATION:
Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Hospitality, Event Management, or equivalent.

title: Docs Business Analyst II
jobDescription:
ROLE:
As a Docs Business Analyst II, you will play a key role in bridging client requirements and product solutions within our core delivery team. You will work closely with Product Solution Leads, SMEs, and clients to analyse, configure, and implement product solutions across the full software development lifecycle. This role requires a detail-oriented problem-solver with strong communication skills and a passion for translating complex business needs into functional, well-configured solutions.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Assist the Product Solution Lead/Manager in driving the implementation. Analyse, configure, and resolve product configuration issues in a timely and systematic manner
- Primary responsibility. Understand and analyse client requirements, and translate them into a functional solution and configure the solution in the product. Work closely with SME/Product Owner and Client to establish exact requirements and manage expectations. Participate in the full life cycle of design, development, and testing phases. Identify issues, structure, and conduct necessary analysis and draw conclusions and findings with limited guidance. Work with the technical team on user stories as needed. Answer business questions and concerns raised by the client, as needed. Maintain requirements traceability and conduct unit testing against requirements. Participate in project planning, tracking, and sprint ceremonies. Must have skills: 2-4+ years of experience as a Business Analyst or in similar roles. Experience working directly with clients. Proficient in HTML and CSS. Experience with SDLC methodologies. Experience working on user story creation and defect tracking tools (IBM, JIRA, Azure, etc.). Proficient with MS Office. Strong logic building and application skills. Strong verbal, written communication, and active listening skills. Excellent organizational and interpersonal skills. Understanding of SQL queries. Ability to multi-task and handle tight deadlines under pressure. Ability to solve problems independently and provide guidance to team members. A zeal to learn and apply learning to new situations. Ability to collaborate across different teams and stakeholders. Good to have: Experience in configuration/implementation of BPM or document management tools. Knowledge of any programming language. Any experience with the US healthcare industry
- basic knowledge works too.

EDUCATION:
Engineering or Management degree is desirable.

title: Director - Solutions Delivery
jobDescription:
ROLE:
As Director
- Solutions Delivery, you will be responsible for overseeing the efficient delivery of our global platform and solutions portfolio while championing operational excellence and client satisfaction. You will have the opportunity to scale delivery capabilities, build high-performing teams, and drive innovation. The role requires a strategic thinker with hands-on experience in managing delivery operations and strong expertise in the US healthcare domain.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Develop and execute the solutions delivery strategy in alignment with organizational goals and business priorities. Manage the portfolio of projects, balancing operational efficiency, quality, and innovation. Support the organization’s transformation journey by incorporating AI-led innovation and automation into delivery workflows. Scale global delivery operations to support expanding product lines and achieve high-growth objectives. Implement and maintain effective governance frameworks, Agile methodologies, and delivery best practices. Establish and monitor KPIs related to quality, timelines, customer satisfaction (CSAT), Net Promoter Score (NPS), and cost optimization. Lead and mentor regional delivery leaders to enhance process maturity and embed innovation and a customer-first mindset within the team. Contribute to the creation of Centers of Excellence (Co Es) focused on Agile practices, Dev Ops, and AI-based transformation. Act as a point of escalation for delivery-related challenges and ensure alignment with client objectives and business expectations. Partner with clients to build long-term strategic relationships and ensure the successful delivery of high-quality solutions. Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams across Product, Engineering, and Go-to-Market (GTM) functions to deliver seamless implementations and maximize ROI for clients. Must have skills: 12+ years of experience in IT/software delivery, with 5+ years in leadership roles. Proven experience in managing medium-to-large-scale delivery operations for North American clients. Strong knowledge of the US healthcare/payer domain, particularly with software solutions and platforms. Experience managing complex programs with high budgets and delivering consistent outcomes. Expertise in Agile frameworks, Dev Ops practices, and program delivery management. Sound business acumen with a focus on driving operational efficiency and profitability. Strong stakeholder management, client engagement, and problem-resolution skills. Experience working in high-growth and fast-paced environments.

EDUCATION:
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering is required; MBA or equivalent is preferred.

title: Associate Product Manager
jobDescription:
ROLE:
As an Associate Product Manager, you will serve as a bridge across products and clients while working closely with the Architect & Development Team, key customer stakeholders, subject matter experts, Product Managers, and operational sales and support teams. You will share responsibility for managing the new Business Unit and formally launching new enhanced product functionality and new strategic product lines.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Work with SMEs (Subject Matter Experts), Business Analysts, and Product Managers to drive operational improvements for customers and streamline the standard product implementation workflow. Proactively solve problems and communication issues with the development, engineering, and implementation teams. Drive products through their end-to-end lifecycle from reviewing and approving requirements and scope, working collaboratively through to execution and delivery. Review and approve technical requirement communication and define precise data set requirements for external and internal stakeholders. Help define the product strategy, product roadmap, and develop a deep understanding of healthcare customer service representatives’ pain points and market trends. Maintain and track product line metrics. Build relationships and collaborate cross-functionally across the LOB (Line of Business) to develop compelling value propositions and messaging to retain and grow the client base. Understand customer needs through research and market data. Define Product Backlog along with Minimum Viable Product (MVP) features needed for new capabilities, and draw on an Agile mindset
- implement the minimal scope that could stand on its own without negatively impacting existing functionality, and rapidly iterate based on user and market feedback. Develop project plans and ensure that implementations are completed on time and meet client expectations. Conduct pre-sales product demonstrations or provide assistance in scoping projects or developing proposals. Must have skills: 4+ years of related work experience in Product Management. 5+ years of related work experience in Healthcare; Health Plan experience is a strong plus. 2+ years of related work experience supervising and guiding other team members. Data-driven storytelling ability with excellent communication skills. Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills to interact with clients regularly. Ability to lead translating customer needs into Product Backlog definition including capabilities and features, with strong organizational skills, customer empathy, and ability to work with ambiguity and changing priorities. Detail oriented. Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, technically focused environment. Good to have: Previous demonstration or webinar experience.

EDUCATION:
Associate’s Degree required; Bachelor’s Degree in a related field preferred.
